HEADLINE:
NYPCB might halt BT substrate price increase in Q4 after significant hikes in Q3.
OUR TAKE:
Co. noted ABF pricing still looking to rise double digits QoQ in both Q3/Q426
supported by AI demand/spec upgrades. Meanwhile, Panasonic reportedly raised
CCL pricing again, lifting IC substrate cost by 30%, which will support pricing
upward trend.

While we lower the 2026E EPS by 4% on a
reduced BT price hike in 4Q26E, we keep the 2027-28E EPS largely
unchanged. We reaffirm our Buy (1) call and raise our 12-month TP to
TWD2,460 (from TWD2,444), based on an unchanged target PER of 49x
applied to the 1-year forward EPS. Downside risk: weaker-than-expected
demand for switches.

南電進入新一輪ABF 景氣上行週期，短期2H26 受惠昆
山廠ABF 稼動率提升，AI 伺服器與1.6T 交換器需求強
勁，加上原物料成本與ABF 現貨供需溢價持續反映至價
格，營收及獲利結構具龐大向上空間；中長期嘉義太保
新廠預計最快2028 年投產，營運預期更上一層樓，維
持買進評等，目標價調升至1700 元(30x2027EPS)。

Maintain Buy on NYPCB, as the key spot price ABF substrate supplier in the market
which should benefit strongly from the S/D shortage and pricing hike in the
foreseeable future, with an unchanged TP of NT$2,500 (based on 21x 2028E EPS).

We lift PT from NT$875 to NT$1,150 based on 25x 2028E P/E (unchanged) on EPS
upward revisions of 26%/48%/33% for 2026/2027/2028E as we were too conservative
on its pricing power (and hence raising sales/margin assumptions) and also factoring
more volume growth from 2028 on the new capacity expansion announcement. We
remain Neutral considering risks on either side - it is in position to enjoy growth from
800G/1.6T transition with favourable pricing upside; but also more susceptible to
demand and price fluctuations as a tier two supplier relatively to Ibiden/Unimicron.

我們重申對南電的買進評等，並將目標股價由1,500元（以45倍
2027年預估每股稅後盈餘計算）上調至1,600元（以43倍2027年預估每股稅後
盈餘計算）。我們預估的主要風險包括：1）T-glass供應，以及2）ABF/BT價格。

We think the stock's narrative is unchanged: gross margins
should expand q/q throughout CY26 and CY27, driven by cost inflation first,
followed by undersupply of substrate capacity from CY27 onward. We view the
stock as inexpensive at 17.5x 2028e P/E, and maintain OW.

Overall, considering the near term profitability outperformance and the positive
long term revenue/earning outlook with the new high-end capacity expansion, we
maintain our Buy rating (on CL) on NYPCB with new TP of NT$2,500 (from
NT$2,310).

NYPCB posted strong 2Q26 GM beat as other ABF peers. We’ve detailed our
ABF/BT thesis for each of major Taiwanese peers in this report. For NYPCB,
we see upside from: 1) product mix enhancement, 2) price hikes and 3) UTR
improvement in its China plant. Although NYPCB just announced an
aggressive capex plan for its capacity expansion, we think this expansion
would be a greenfield project which likely wouldn’t come online until late-
2028. In the near term, we think the company would focus more on
debottlenecking its existing plants or likely retrofitting some capacity.
Overall, we remain bullish on NYPCB and slightly raise our DCF-based TP to
NT$1,600 (implied 30x 2027E EPS). Reiterate our Buy rating.
Stay OW: on a 12-month view, we prefer Unimicron over NYPCB and Zhen Ding.

800G/1.6T高階交換器及ASIC Server需求成長，公司為Broadcom高階
Switch第二大ABF供應商，受惠大客戶願意支付較高溢價鎖定料源，加上南電

已於1Q26開始供貨，有助於緩解公司原料漲價壓力並提升載板出貨量，
預期公司毛利率改善速度將為同業中最顯著。

寸、板層數持續提升及良率下降，預估ABF產業供需缺口將提前於2H26浮現，
並於2027-2028年擴大，緊缺程度將高於過往上行期，管理層亦上修2Q26毛
利率展望至季增5ppts以上，並預期2H26毛利率增速將逐季擴大；其中ABF業
務，現每季約調漲價格10%，2Q26 ABF毛利率約25-29%，2027年即有望重
返前波循環近60%的高峰水準。BT載板方面，受惠記憶體需求強勁及同業逐
步淡出BT市場，供需將進一步趨緊，公司預估2H26 BT毛利率即可重返1H22
約30-33%之水準，公司整體獲利表現將於2027年重返高峰期。

T-glass缺料緩解速度不如預期。

緊，產能利用率與產品組合持續改善，EPS 27.53 元。建議給予44 倍本益
比，目標價1,210 元（44X 2027F EPS），投資評等「買進」。

We attribute the recent ABF weakness (sector has underperformed Taiex by 16-
23% since early May) to a lack of monthly sales surprises, with rising concerns
about pricing power and expectation misses, after strong share price rallies YTD.
We expect strong margin expansion in 2Q26 and more price hikes in 2H26 to put
an end to the pricing power debate for the ABF sector, and we view this as only
the first potential quarterly beat in this upcycle, and see much more to come with
more favourable pricing terms into 2027/28. We raise 26/27SP EPS by 29%/18%
and our target PE to 40x, lifting our TP from NT$840 to NT$1,300. Outperform.

We raise our 2026-28E EPS by 11-49% to factor in
higher-than-expected price hikes from both raw materials and substrates.
We reaffirm our Buy (1) call and raise our 12-month TP to TWD1,444 (from
TWD1,222), based on an unchanged target PER multiple of 49x applied to
our 1-year-forward EPS. We view our target PER multiple as undemanding
as 2026-28E PEG (EPS CAGR at 120%) comes in at only 0.4x. Downside
risks: weaker-than-expected demand for switches/PCs/smartphones.

缺口加劇，南電整體營運進入快速擴張階段，參考產業PE 上緣40X，考

元，維持「買進」投資建議。

MSe but remain in line with the Street. We continue to see margin improvement,
with April net margin at 13.4% – a 170bps increase vs 1Q26 net margin of 11.7% –
likely driven by better pricing, improved mix, and higher utilization rates for ABF and
BT substrates. We reiterate OW, as we believe the AI-driven upcycle remains in its
early innings, with undersupply emerging from CY27 onward. We
prefer Unimicron over NYPCB and Zhen Ding on a 12-month view.

Though 1Q GM missed investors’ high expectations, our thesis for the ABF
sector remains unchanged and looks even more robust considering rising
demand from server CPU. We remain positive about the upcoming price
hikes from 2Q26 and believe the ABF industry would face a severe ABF
capacity shortage in 2027, if we assume no T glass constraint. Among Taiwan
peers, NYPCB is more on flexible pricing and capacities (ie, less LTAs)
compared to others. We believe NYPCB should see the strongest ASP
growth driven by more aggressive price hikes. We raise our TP to NT$1,100
(implied 30x 2027E EPS).

will expand q/q throughout CY26 and CY27, driven by cost inflation first, followed
by undersupply of substrate capacity. As a result, we continue to encourage
accumulating, if there's any pullback.
Maintain our Buy rating (on CL) on NYPCB, with a new TP of NT$1,115.

Key Takeaways:
1.NYPCB's 3Q GM was 9.6% (+150bps q/q, +370bps y/y), 80/90bps below MSe/
Consensus, which management attributed to FX headwinds from 2Q.
2.3Q OpM was 5.7% (+180bps q/q, +430bps y/y), 100/90bps below MSe/
Consensus, for OP of NT$620mn (+69% q/q, +396% y/y), 15%/13% below MSe/
Consensus.
3.Thus, 3Q NP came in at NT$725mn (+1,131% y/y), 8%/2% below MSe/Consensus,
for EPS of NT$1.12.
Our view: The appreciation of NTD against USD in 2Q had a deferred impact on 3Q
gross margin, which led to the 80/90bps miss vs. our estimate/Street, despite the
sequential increases in UTRs across the board and price hikes for a portion of its BT
substrates in 3Q. However, compared to its TW peers, Unimicron and Kinsus,
NYPCB's GM did not miss by as much, echoing what we mentioned in a previous
note. We think aside from its different pricing strategy (more tied to spot
prices of raw materials), NYPCB's customer mix is also what allows it to have more
bargaining power to raise prices with its customers, which will help on margin
expansion. We do not argue against the fact that fundamentals are improving for
both ABF and BT, but NYPCB's stretched valuation remains our top concern.
